label: Additional commitment, not attributed to Aristotle: every being is…, by Well-founded-induction
meaning: A link of VIII.5's series is a mover other than the moved thing that some other thing moves; by Physics III.3 it is then being moved, so by the second-movers premise it is a per se link. Accessibility under the per se links transfers to VIII.5's links. This transfers accessibility as an additional commitment; it does not identify accessibility with the weaker source-level prohibition of infinitely many distinct movers.
